name: DEV Community: #ai tag

rules_quotes.quote: Disclose the fact that they were generated or assisted by AI in the post, either upfront using the tag #ABotWroteThis or at any point in the article’s copy (including right at the end).
we ask that you not use bots or AI to generate comments on posts, whether the post was published by you or another community member.

notes: Open tag feed on DEV for posts about artificial intelligence; any member can publish a post with the tag, and AI-assisted posts must follow DEV's AI guidelines.

name: DEV Community: #showdev tag

rules_quotes.quote: Please make posts community-driven and not overly corporate or salesy.

notes: Tag for showing off projects and launching products; any member publishes a post with the tag and keeps it community-driven rather than salesy.

name: DEV Community: #discuss tag

name: freeCodeCamp News

rules_quotes.quote: Don't submit any text written by AI. We can tell when text is written by AI.

notes: Large free developer publication; writers draft in Hashnode, submit to the editorial team, and are published after review.

name: Smashing Magazine

rules_quotes.quote: We do not publish articles which are an obvious attempt at content marketing.
pieces full of links to your product, or which are a walkthrough of how to use your product, will be rejected.

notes: Web design and development magazine that pays authors; outsiders send a pitch through the contact form and write after approval.

name: InfoQ

rules_quotes.quote: We reject primarily AI-generated work.

notes: Software engineering news site; outsiders submit an article proposal that editors review within a stated 5 to 7 working days.

name: A List Apart

rules_quotes.quote: Please don’t send us press releases or sales pitches.

notes: Long-running web design and development magazine; outsiders send a draft or short pitch with an outline for editorial feedback.

name: Towards Data Science

rules_quotes.quote: Is your conclusion to the point and not promotional?
Adding an extra link to your author profile or to a social media account is fine, but please avoid call-to-action (CTA) buttons.

notes: Data science and AI publication that takes outside author submissions through its submission page.

name: HackerNoon

rules_quotes.quote: we neither accept nor encourage the use of AI to generate text
Using AI for assistance, such as improving grammar or polishing prose, is perfectly acceptable.

notes: Independent tech publication; anyone creates an account, writes in its editor and submits the story for staff editor review.

name: Towards AI

rules_quotes.quote: disclose AI-generated text within the first two paragraphs and label AI-generated images in their captions.
Please discuss these pieces with us before submitting.

notes: AI publication on Medium; outsiders follow it and submit an unpublished Medium draft, with no application form needed.

name: Medium

rules_quotes.quote: First party promotion is allowed, and you may promote and link to your own business, website, mailing list, or fundraiser.
Third-party advertising and sponsorships are not allowed.
Performing a disproportionately large number of interactions, particularly by automated means.

notes: Open publishing platform; anyone with an account can publish stories or submit them to Medium publications under the Medium Rules.

name: Substack

rules_quotes.quote: Substack is intended for high quality editorial content, not conventional email marketing.

notes: Newsletter and publishing platform; anyone can start a free publication and publish posts under the Substack content guidelines.

name: DigitalOcean Community: Write for DOnations
notes: Paid tutorial program; outsiders apply with a topic idea, outline and writing sample, then work with an editor.
